correctness.rationale: Every 1- and 2-simplex has exactly one oriented Hamiltonian-cycle completion as described; 24 maximal triangles form six tetrahedron boundaries glued only at vertices. The connected 18-vertex/24-edge incidence graph yields seven 1-cycles; the six spheres yield rank-six H2 integrally, without torsion. The equivariant graph exact sequence and signed fixed-tetrahedron characters give the full 48-element action. check_omega4.py independently reproduces all finite claims using exhaustive enumeration and integer character arithmetic.

value.rationale: This identifies the first connected cycle-free chessboard complex explicitly as a mixed-dimensional wedge (six 2-spheres and seven circles), rather than only proving it connected, and gives complete joint symmetry representations in both degrees. The directed Hamiltonian-cycle cover and incidence-graph model are natural structural descriptions and a reproducible benchmark for multipath and symmetric-homology topology.
